title: GAO closes NNSA production-modernization schedule-requirement Recommendation 1
summary: GAO records Recommendation 1 Closed-Implemented after NNSA revised its Program Execution Instruction to require applicable Production Modernization programs to follow all ten GAO schedule best practices.
